FSD.Settings.StoryDecksMenu.Name: Story Decks
FSD.Settings.StoryDecksMenu.Label: Configure Decks
FSD.Settings.StoryDecksMenu.Hint: Journal button, GM session panel, portrait spotlighting, and the connections round.
FSD.Settings.StoryDecisionsMenu.Name: Story Decisions
FSD.Settings.StoryDecisionsMenu.Label: Configure Decisions
FSD.Settings.StoryDecisionsMenu.Hint: Prompt players with story-driving choices at the start of a session.
FSD.Settings.PortraitSpotlightHint: When a player is handed a card, raise their character's portrait using Ginzzzu's Portraits. Has no effect unless that module is active.
FSD.Settings.PortraitSoloHint: Lower the previous speaker's portrait when the spotlight moves on. Turn off to let a card's speakers accumulate on screen.
FSD.Settings.ConnectionsHint: Add a Connections tab to the Story Deck window, where the GM hands each character's connection questions to the other players one at a time. While this is on, players can't edit the Connections field on their sheet by hand — the GM still can.
FSD.Settings.ConnectionsHintUnavailable: Requires the Daggerheart system — the round reads the connection questions from the character sheet, which only Daggerheart provides.
FSD.Connections.Intro: Each character's connection questions, answered by the rest of the table.
FSD.Connections.EndConfirm: End the connections round? Any question still out will be dropped. Answers already given are kept.
FSD.Connections.NeedsTwo: Connections need at least two players online — someone has to answer for someone else.
FSD.Connections.NoneOnline: No players with a character are online.
FSD.Connections.AskLead: Who should answer this for you?
FSD.Connections.StatsHeading: Who has answered how much tonight
FSD.Connections.WaitingChoose: Waiting for {name} to choose who answers…
FSD.Connections.AlreadyRunning: A connection question is already out. Finish or cancel it first.
FSD.Connections.AskerOffline: {name} is offline — they need to be connected to choose who answers.
FSD.Connections.NoCandidates: Nobody else is online to answer this.
FSD.Connections.PickUnavailable: That player can no longer answer this question.
FSD.Connections.QuestionGone: That question is no longer on the sheet — the answer wasn't saved.
FSD.Connections.ActorGone: That character no longer exists — the answer wasn't saved.
FSD.Connections.WriteFailed: Couldn't write the answer to the character sheet. See the console (F12) for the reason.
FSD.Connections.NoQuestions: No connection questions on this sheet yet.
FSD.Connections.NoCharacters: No players have a character assigned.
FSD.Connections.LockedHint: Connections are answered by the other players during the connections round.
FSD.Connections.ResetConfirm: Erase every connection answer from the session and from all character sheets? The questions stay; this can't be undone.
FSD.Settings.ShowGMHudHint: Show the small on-screen session panel while a Story Deck is running, with a shortcut button that opens the Story Deck window. Only affects your own screen; players always see the panel during a session.
FSD.Settings.ShowJournalButtonHint: Show the Story Deck and Story Decision launch buttons in the Journal sidebar header. Only ever visible to the GM.

FSD.StoryDecision.OptionDescriptionPlace: Optional detail shown to players about this option.
FSD.StoryDecision.ClearConfirm: Clear the title, description, and all options? This can't be undone.

FSD.StoryDecision.NeedsPlayer: Choose a player for a Single decision before asking.
FSD.StoryDecision.AlreadyVoting: A Story Decision is already open for voting.
FSD.StoryDecision.NoVotesYet: Nobody has voted yet. Click End Voting again to end it anyway.
FSD.StoryDecision.NotEveryoneVoted: Not everyone has voted yet. Click End Voting again to end it anyway.
